prompts.name: 精致三维卡通风
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: adult female NPC portrait style audition for the existing PCShopSell life simulation game.
Create ONE polished portrait, style 01: refined contemporary stylized 3D character render (精致三维卡通风). Use the attached old portrait ONLY as a character identity/costume reference. Discard its retro drawing style completely. The character is Lu Zhi / 陆栀, explicitly an adult 27-year-old Chinese woman, an original collectible-model artist. She should be strikingly beautiful and appealing, with an elegant youthful adult face, warm expressive almond brown eyes, softly waved chin-to-shoulder length chestnut brown bob, wispy side fringe, small white gardenia flower with green leaves hair clip on her right side (viewer left). Warm cream fair skin, subtle natural makeup and a confident gentle smile. Preserve the dark indigo cropped work jacket with warm ochre topstitching and brass buttons over a cream and charcoal thin striped crew-neck shirt, small geometric craft brooch. One hand loosely holding her own small sketchbook at waist. Same identity, same clothing, same calm pose to use for all ten auditions.
Composition: vertical 3:4, single character waist-up, eye-level three-quarter face gently turned toward viewer, full head and shoulders with comfortable margins. Plain cool pale sage-gray studio backdrop, faint soft grounding light, no scene objects or graphic frame. Soft daylight from upper left, warm skin light, broad soft shadows. Restrained indigo/sage/cream/ochre palette relates to the game's clean low-poly 3D town, but portrait is attractively polished rather than blocky.
For this style use beautifully modeled smooth 3D volumes, restrained stylized proportions and realistic adult face shape, fine sculpted hair clumps, subtle physically plausible materials, appealing clear expressive eyes, sophisticated game-quality cinematic render. Must be clearly 3D, NOT an illustration with retro hatching. No childlike proportions, no toddler/chibi face, no sexualized outfit, no excessive cleavage, no photographic real person, no paper grain, no sepia, no vintage manga, no etched lines, no text, no watermark, no number labels.
